# Mortar Works Ltd

> Mortar is a London-based technology company that builds intelligent systems
> redefining relationships between people, places, and property. It designs
> and delivers data and intelligence platforms for corporate, place-based,
> government, and health institutions — delivering lasting impact across the
> public and social sectors. Mortar is founded and led by George Unsworth,
> one of the UK's leading systems and service designers.

## About

Mortar Works Ltd (mortar.works) operates at the intersection of service
design, system architecture, and applied AI. The organisation works with
local authorities, NHS trusts, housing associations, combined authorities,
and cultural institutions across the UK.

Mortar's AI lab, Hxly, pioneers work in service and behavioural intelligence,
applying advanced behavioural modelling to real-world data to surface patterns,
predictions, and drive meaningful decisions in complex public sector contexts.

## Services

- **Service Design**: User research and insight, journey mapping, co-design
  workshops, prototyping, service blueprints, and implementation support.
  Mortar accelerates delivery of custom service solutions by modelling user
  behaviour and building persona libraries shaped by real users.

- **System Design**: Technical discovery and audit, scalable architecture
  design, API design and integration strategy, data architecture, and security
  and compliance by design. Mortar architects resilient digital systems that
  integrate with existing infrastructure.

- **Intelligence Design**: Data strategy, data architecture, interoperability
  and standards, data governance, demand forecasting, and simulation and
  scenario planning. Mortar builds the analytical models and intelligence
  systems organisations need to understand complexity and act with confidence.

## Products

### Hoop'd — Integrated Services Platform
Hoop'd delivers data sharing solutions across local area partnerships and
networks. It combines 24 service modules and 5 publicly backed frameworks
(Health, Skills, Referral, Accreditation, Directories) to connect fragmented
organisations into intelligent services supporting hundreds of thousands of
service users.

### Hxly — Service Intelligence and AI Lab
Hxly is Mortar's AI research lab developing custom models and datasets for
complex problems where rare but significant outcomes matter most. Capabilities
include trusted data environments, imbalanced data handling, simulation and
scenario testing, explainable outputs, and responsible AI.

## Solutions

Mortar offers a suite of purpose-built solutions including: Community Navigator,
Digital Noticeboard, Directories Builder, Digital Skills and Help Finder,
Triage Tool, First Point Case Manager, Tenancy Sustainment Tool, Referral
Platform, Forma (population intelligence and digital twin), Model Builder,
DataSafe (Trusted Data Environments), and Venue Accreditation Tool.

## Industries Served

- **Government**: Local authorities, combined authorities, and government
  agencies. Integrated data platforms, needs analysis, policy impact modelling,
  digital public services.

- **Health**: NHS trusts, integrated care boards, primary care networks.
  Population health intelligence, early intervention tools, integrated care
  coordination infrastructure.

- **Housing**: Housing associations and local authority housing departments.
  Tenancy intelligence, resident engagement, compliance intelligence,
  health-housing integration.

- **Cultural Sector**: Galleries, museums, theatres, libraries, and arts
  centres. Audience intelligence, community engagement, impact measurement,
  digital participation.

- **Asset Management**: Housing providers, local authorities, public
  infrastructure managers. Predictive maintenance, portfolio intelligence,
  capital investment modelling, social value measurement.

## Key Facts

- Founded and led by George Unsworth
- Based in London, United Kingdom
- Operates across public sector, health, housing, and cultural sectors
- UK-based data infrastructure; data never leaves UK jurisdiction (DataSafe)
